died.name: Marcus Junius Brutus
died.desc: Roman senator and assassin of Julius Caesar
died.cause: after defeat at the Battle of Philippi. He then bade his friends farewell before killing himself
died.last_words: By all means must we fly; not with our feet, however, but with our hands.

died.name: Hannah Twynnoy
died.cause: The 33-year-old barmaid at the White Lion Inn was mauled to death by a tiger in Malmesbury, Wiltshire. She was the first person to be killed by a tiger in British history.

died.name: Al Jolson
died.last_words: This is it! I'm going. I'm going.

died.name: Helen Palmer
died.desc: American children's author, editor and philanthropist
died.cause: in her suicide note, addressed to her husband, Theodor "Dr. Seuss" Geisel
died.last_words: Dear Ted, what has happened to us? I don't know. I feel myself in a spiral, going down down down, into a black hole from which there is no escape, no brightness. And loud in my ears from every side I hear, 'failure, failure, failure...' I love you so much ... I am too old and enmeshed in everything you do and are, that I cannot conceive of life without you ... My going will leave quite a rumor but you can say I was overworked and overwrought. Your reputation with your friends and fans will not be harmed ... Sometimes think of the fun we had all thru the years ...

born.name: Turner Ashby
born.desc: Confederate cavalry commander of the American Civil War
born.cause: before being killed at Harrisonburg, Virginia
born.last_words: Charge Men! For God's sake charge!

born.name: Sarah Bernhardt
born.last_words: How slow my death agony is.
